entities.name: PMID:25451237
observations: 2015 Alcohol and Alcoholism study tested Ucn3-knockout and wild-type littermates with ethanol access before and after chronic inflammatory pain induction.
The paper reports that increased alcohol consumption in Ucn3-knockout mice was unaffected by chronic inflammatory pain.

entities.name: UCN3
observations: Ucn3-knockout mice consumed significantly more ethanol and showed greater ethanol preference than wild-type controls across the reported time course.

Chronic inflammatory pain produced no long-term change in alcohol drinking behavior in either genotype, leaving the knockout-associated increase unmodified; exact interaction statistics were unavailable in the retrieved abstract.
